summary: 4 runs, 4 PASS, across two pre-specified positions (100 cm and 115 cm). L1 stayed 2.26-2.45 against the deployed model 2.29, i.e. a well-conditioned fit every time. Acoustic difference 1.07 to 2.52 dB, overshoot -0.93 to +0.12 dB, all inside the acceptance rule.
limits: 115 cm is the longest distance the room allows, so the change between positions is only +15 cm; this shows repeatability within 15 cm, not at arbitrary distances.
one short 16384-frame window per arm is evidence of the 322 Hz loop, not proof of audible benefit.
no statement is made about moving during use or about distances beyond 115 cm.
